display_name: MiniMax H3 Image + Audio Lipsync (8-step turbo)
description: Animates a portrait so it speaks/sings a supplied audio track. MiniMaxH3AddGuide anchors the audio at frame 0 (kept, never denoised) while MiniMax H3 generates matching mouth motion. Works on flat 2D cartoons ( Set frames to cover the audio: frames = audio_seconds * 24, snapped up to 5+17n (6.4s -> 158). Width/height must match the portrait's aspect ratio (image is stretched to fit). ~3 min per 6s clip when models are warm Put the spoken words in the prompt as (S1): <d>[English] words</d>. Needs at least 18 GB of swap active (~44GB RAM peak) and nothing else on the GPU. To re-sync EXISTING footage (dubbing a filmed or rendered clip) use LatentSync instead: LatentSync. Long jobs return status 'running': poll get_job_result with wait_seconds.

prompt.description: Describe the character talking (style, framing, expression) and include the transcript as (S1): <d>[English] words</d>; end with 'Audio: the provided voice track only'

input_image.description: Portrait / first frame (local path, uploaded automatically)

input_audio.description: Driving speech or song (local path, uploaded automatically; wav/mp3/flac)

width.description: Video width (multiple of 32), same aspect as the portrait

height.description: Video height (multiple of 32), same aspect as the portrait

frames.description: Frame count at 24fps covering the audio length, snapped up to 5+17n (124=~5s, 158=~6.6s, 362=15s)

steps.description: Sampling steps (8 matches the turbo LoRA)
